title: Surgeborn Superhero Co-op Third-Person ARPG!
author: luka06111
selftext:
Hi guys i've posted my game here a while ago. And quite alot of it has changed. I would love for you to take a look into it from my video and also by playing. You can join discord server and message for a key and i'll get you one right away. 

If you have any feedback regarding the game please tell me no matter how harsh it is. I wanna improve it and launch it on Steam and Playstore. I'm improving it day by day.

Thank you so much for your time! Any questions drop below

[Itch.io](https://luka0611.itch.io/surgesuperhero)  
[Discord Server](https://discord.gg/5RqkmScCt)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/luka06111 this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development. Saying you used AI isn't the same as explaining how. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: luka06111
comments.body: Claude code + Unity and yes all Claude code. With antigravity for some assets (I feel they have the best vision)

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body: Need a lot of time in the oven. UI immediately out itself as Claude's default decisions and also clashes with the comic book style theme of the game itself.

replies.author: luka06111
replies.body: I agree it needs alot of time still just want a bit of support, also can you detail the ui part, and game isn't supposed to be comic book styled. It's more towards a almost realistic style. But the ui I really wanna understand cause I changed it alot from when Claude did it. And thank you for the feedback
